title: Snow at the Observatory
brief: Write a locked-room style mystery at a mountain observatory cut off by snow. The telescope's main mirror cover was closed during a clear night, ruining a once-a-decade observation. Four people were present. The astronomer-protagonist solves it by the end.
worldBible: The observatory sits at 3,100 metres; the cable car stops when wind passes 60 km/h.
The mirror cover can be closed from the control room or by a hand crank in the dome.
The control room logs every command with a timestamp; the hand crank leaves no log.
The night of the incident the cable car was stopped from 21:00 until morning.
The once-a-decade event is the occultation of a bright star by an asteroid at 02:14.
Snow outside the dome door was undisturbed at dawn.

mustHold.fact: The cable car was stopped from 21:00 until morning, so nobody arrived or left overnight.
mustHold.violationExample: Teodor came up on the cable car at 23:30, unseen.

mustHold.fact: The hand crank leaves no log entry.
mustHold.violationExample: The crank had logged a timestamp at 02:09.

mustHold.fact: Ines narrates in the first person.
mustHold.violationExample: Ines thought to herself that she was missing something.

probes.question: Is the occultation still at 02:14?
probes.passExample: The occultation would come at 02:14 and last under four seconds.

probes.question: Is Kofi still left-handed?
probes.passExample: Kofi moved the bishop with his left hand without looking.
probes.failExample: Kofi, right-handed, reached for the crank.

probes.question: Is the snow outside the dome door undisturbed?
probes.passExample: The snow at the dome door lay unbroken, no prints at all.
probes.failExample: There were footprints in the snow outside the dome door.
